title: reviewed
description: One review of the issue's pull request finished. Written by the loop from the reviewer's answer. Not a stage and not progress. A retried write can repeat it: count one per answer_path.

verdict.description: approve, changes (findings to fix), or unknown (no valid answer).

round.description: The review round in this life, from 1.

patch.description: The patch id reviewed: an approval holds for exactly this patch.

reviewer.description: Which reviewer answered, for example adjudicator.

ui_capture.description: The repo's UI capture policy the review ran under: command (a capture command is set), none (capture is off, so a missing capture is at most a warning) or unset. Optional: absent or null on a review recorded before the field existed.

answer_path.description: The reviewer's answer file on the loop's device. Identifies the review: one event per answer.
